body:
A reader writes:

 I’ve been giving select people copies of Faith After Doubt .  Last night I had dinner with a youngish fellow who entered perplexity at the time he left ministry.

 He said to me “I had no idea, I thought my wife and I were the only ones”.  That kind of isolation still shocks me since you and I have been in the conversation so long.

 We then talked about how badly there is a need for “safe spaces just to talk”.

 It reawakened my sensitivity to how many out there are not even aware the conversation is going on.

 Your work is bearing good fruit.

 Thanks to all who share books … they become a gateway out of isolation and into conversation.
